north_outer.name: North Outer Section (Samaypur Badli ⮂ Vishwavidyalaya)
north_outer.description: Outer North Delhi sector. Operates at lower frequency when central short-turn loops terminate at Vishwavidyalaya.
north_outer.verification_note: Marked unverified until confirmed by physical platform counts.

central_core.name: Central Core Section (Vishwavidyalaya ⮂ Qutab Minar)
central_core.description: High-density core through Old Delhi, Connaught Place, and South Delhi with interleaved short-turn services.
central_core.verification_note: Interleaved service pattern with ~150s peak headway.

south_outer.name: South Outer Section (Qutab Minar ⮂ Millennium City Centre)
south_outer.description: Gurugram elevated sector. If enable_south_shuttle is set to true, extra Qutab–Gurugram shuttles run, raising frequency here so north_outer becomes the only reduced-frequency end.
south_outer.verification_note: Marked unverified until confirmed by physical platform counts. GTFS hints south has extra shuttles.
